answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a diversity quorum: an identity's work counts only when at least three independent verifier clusters, with no shared operator, tooling, or history, each confirm it, like a lotus that opens only when light comes from several directions, not one lamp. A velvet-smooth fake farm can pass one cluster, but buying approval from three unrelated clusters per fake triples its cost, while a willow bending in one honest wind passes once. Fakes sharing a cluster are discounted together, so cloning multiplies expense without multiplying reward.
